faqs.question: What is iApp Technologies LLP?
faqs.answer: iApp Technologies LLP is a software development company founded in 2012, specialising in mobile app development, web application development, and AI-powered digital products for startups and enterprises worldwide.

faqs.question: What services does iApp Technologies offer?
faqs.answer: iApp Technologies offers mobile app development (iOS & Android), web application development, AI-powered product development, custom software solutions, and UI/UX design.

faqs.question: When was iApp Technologies founded?
faqs.answer: iApp Technologies LLP was founded in 2012 and has been delivering technology solutions for over a decade.

faqs.question: What products has iApp Technologies built?
faqs.answer: iApp Technologies has built products including CaseRoom, Poster Maker, an IPTV platform, a Taxi Booking App, and an AI Ad Management Tool.

faqs.question: How can I contact iApp Technologies?
faqs.answer: Visit https://iapptechnologies.com/contact or connect via LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.
